construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Site was the 70-unit Mountain View Gardens Apartments (11 two-story buildings) on about 4.07 acres at the northwest corner of S Rengstorff Ave and Latham St. Council approved the 85-unit rowhouse project on 2021-09-14 (Resolution No. 18601 for the Vesting Tentative Map), with removal of 38 Heritage trees.

Approved design: two-car garages for all units plus 31 guest parking spaces; Spanish Colonial style; about 62,506 sq ft of open area (35%). Park Land Dedication in-lieu fees for 15 net new units estimated at $720,000.

Council report states the applicant entity changed during review, finalized in 2020. Final map report names Taylor Morrison of California, LLC as developer and states it paid $1,729,271 in subdivision fees.

City filings list original APNs 148-36-033, 148-36-035 and 148-36-036; these are not in the current county parcel dataset. Record APN 148-45-053 (570 S Rengstorff Av) is one of the subdivided lots numbered 148-45-0xx along S Rengstorff Av. Taylor Morrison markets the project as Amelia, 2116 Latham Street.
